name: Alpha Temenos
_notes: Transcribed from sheet AU0563 (front Lv I / back Lv II-IX), AI AR0522-AR0541 + Mnestis Routine Contract Will, BP AS0543-AS0560, traits AX0517 Song of Hopelessness.
Zone patterns: 'pattern' = list of [depth, lateral] from the centre lane of the front edge (depth 1 = adjacent to front; lateral + = Temenos's right). 'zone': N = Zone N around the whole footprint.
White spaces (Worm of the Labyrinth): rear-row side on Temenos's right, front-row side on Temenos's left, adjacent space in front of the centre (sheet diagram, facing down).
AT icon (circle monster) tokens: positive AT tokens raise BP AT.

vp.name: Broken Pyramid
vp.text: Lv I: Climb Fury 6+. Hold On (End of Primordial Round) Endurance 5+, Fail: displace to an adjacent space, Knockdown. On VP: +1 Power, cannot gain Despair tokens, ignore Primordial Responses. Lv II+: Climb Fury 8+, Hold On Endurance 7+ (Fail: displace to a Rear space, Knockdown). On VP: +1 Power, cannot gain Despair; ignore normal Responses, instead WOUND: gain +2 Danger and immediately Hold On; FAIL: resolve the Hold On fail effect, then Signature against the Attacker.

traits.Labyrinth X: Additional Setup: Place a Labyrinth token on the topmost space of the Labyrinth track. Labyrinth X: Place X Labyrinth Terrain tiles adjacent to and in front of the Primordial. Use the tile shape that corresponds to the token's location on the track (O → L → Z → I), then move the token clockwise to the next space.
traits.Mazesense: Labyrinth tiles do not block Temenos's Line of Sight. Argonauts with the Mazetouched Affliction must apply all ΨX+ effects, regardless of their actual Fate.
traits.Maze Reconfiguration: When Temenos is instructed to place a Labyrinth tile under a Titan that is already standing on a Labyrinth tile, that Titan draws an Obol instead.
traits.Ariadne's Logic: When attacked from a Labyrinth tile, Temenos has -1 AT.
traits.End of Hope: End of Primordial Round: Perform Signature.
traits.Snail of Nothing: Each time Temenos gains a Wound, it gains 1 positive AT token. Next time you resolve an AI card, discard all of the AT tokens and add that many Danger to the Danger dealt by that Attack.
traits.Worm of the Labyrinth: Temenos can only be attacked from the white spaces (marked on the Primordial diagram).
traits.Win Together, Die Alone: Start of Titan turn: If you're not adjacent to another Titan, gain +2 Danger and +2 Fate.
traits.Beginning of the End: End of Primordial Round: Before End of Hope, draw and perform another AI card.
traits.Song of Hopelessness: Despair tokens apply the following stacking penalties (on top of their regular effects): 1+ token: You cannot use Mnemos cards. 2+ tokens: You cannot use exhaustable Gear. 3+ tokens: You cannot perform Move.
traits.Song of Great Fear: Each time you gain a Despair token, you also gain the Fear Condition card.
traits.Doom of the Centimanes: If you're not adjacent to another Titan, you cannot use Fate to re-roll your Attack Rolls, Evasion Rolls and Judgement tests. If you're not adjacent to another Titan and you fully miss an Attack, you die.
traits.Symphony of Despair: Start of Titan turn: Gain 1 Despair token.
traits.Ruthless: Remove all positive Trauma cards from the Trauma decks (except Obols).
